_comment: ROAD-VISUAL-CREATURES 2026-09-07. Authored ordinary colourways for the 32 installed later-biome meshes. Sources: Cloudreach/Stormwood roster boards and docs/art/BIOME_2_3_4_CREATURE_ROSTER.md; Water presentation_intent fields in water_roster.json. These are region repaints of each embedded source albedo, not whole-model tints and not generated assets. Strong primary blocks carry identity at road distance; brighter low-saturation source regions become a restrained contrasting accent. Geometry, roster role and species mapping are unchanged.

pebbik._comment: The installed source already paints the owner board's warm tan body, cream face/chest, blue feather tips and dark eye. The previous broad rules collapsed those anatomical regions into neon yellow and purple. Preserve the source grouping, cap only excessive chroma, and keep its existing facial value hierarchy instead of restamping dark fur noise as features.

craghorn._comment: Burnt-orange cliff body with cool sky highlights.

stormcapra._comment: Electric azure storm coat and warm horn planes.

skyrill._comment: The installed Skyrill mesh is a broad, winged sky-drake rather than the board's compact sail-backed cliff lizard, so a one-hue cyan repaint makes the mismatch worse: it erases the source atlas's blue, coral and cream anatomy and leaves no face at gameplay distance. Preserve that authored regional hierarchy, cap only its hottest chroma, lift the narrow forward head plane, and deepen dark marks only inside that plane. This is a subject-specific presentation repair, not a claim that paint can replace the board silhouette.

voltarach._comment: The installed source already carries the owner board's charcoal shell, warm amber/gold edge planes and clustered blue facial nodes. The previous broad ordinary rules erased that hierarchy into a hot-magenta mass that the combined biome judge singled out. Preserve and restrain the source grouping for ordinary wildlife. The active alpha remains a separate storm-indigo/cyan treatment: the owner explicitly rejected the prior pink alpha, and runtime prefers the authored alpha texture over the vivid fallback.

fulgocobra._comment: Legendary lightning-gold serpent with deep violet planes.

cannonback._comment: Water roster intent: slate shell, cream belly, ochre rim.

riptusk._comment: Water roster intent: slate hide, ivory tusks and ochre spines. The installed source already paints those anatomical blocks; the previous broad coral rule replaced nearly all of them with one hot hue. Keep the source grouping, cap only its strongest chroma, lift the small forward face plane, and recover its darkest eye/mouth marks only inside that face instead of re-stamping dark speckles across the body.

aquaryn._comment: Water Alpha: radiant cyan body and ceremonial gold planes.

tidecoil._comment: Deep violet tide serpent with cyan current markings.

mirejaw._comment: Water roster intent: spotted charcoal/taupe body with muted coral gills. Those regions are already present in the installed source; the previous broad magenta rule flattened both into a black-and-pink mass. Preserve the source grouping, restrain its chroma, lift the forward muzzle, and recover dark eyes/mouth only inside that face instead of amplifying every body spot.

torrentoad._comment: The installed source already separates a slate-blue wet back, pale throat and restrained warm markings. The previous broad orange/teal rules flattened those anatomical blocks and made its already-recessed facial forms harder to locate. Preserve the source grouping, cap only the strongest chroma, and lift the forward upper face plane without inventing replacement eye paint: a bounded anatomy-predicate eye attempt landed as vertical cheek stripes and was rejected. The paired attack source correction grounds every sampled pose, but the mesh's eye/silhouette gap remains an asset-level follow-up.

cragclaw._comment: Water roster intent: rust claws, grey stone and moss shell. The installed source already separates all three, while the previous signal-red first match erased that hierarchy. Preserve the source grouping, restrain only its strongest chroma, lift the narrow central face plane, and recover the dark eye marks only there instead of deepening shell speckles.

riverdrake._comment: River cyan body with orange fin/plate contrast.

sirenseal._comment: Water roster intent: ivory throat, slate body and dusty lilac fins. The installed source already carries that large face/throat block; the previous coral rule turned the whole silhouette hot pink. Preserve the source grouping, cap the blue fins below neon, and lift the upper face while retaining its source eye marks.

mangrove_monitor._comment: Water roster intent: olive mottling, ochre face stripe and dark bark body. The installed source already paints those regions; the previous sun-gold rule collapsed them into one glaring yellow mass. Preserve the source grouping, restrain its strongest chroma, lift the forward upper face, and recover only the dark eye marks there.

abyssal_guardian._comment: Legendary indigo giant with hot magenta abyssal planes.
